# browser — automation engines and testing

## How to use it

Pick the parts that match the task from the table and read those files.
Nothing here needs to be read in full before starting.

## Parts

**Engine choice and driving**

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `parts/browser-automation/` | The chooser: agent-browser (standalone CDP) vs browser-skill (the user's real browser via bsk) vs computer-use (desktop GUI via cua-driver) — start here when the engine is not decided yet |
| `parts/agent-browser/` | Browser automation CLI for AI agents: navigate, fill forms, click, screenshot, extract data, automate any browser task |
| `parts/browsermcp-automation/` | Full browsing "as a human" on the anti-detect Camoufox via BrowserMCP: snapshots with refs, clicks and forms, signups/logins with 2FA (TOTP), content extraction |
| `parts/openai-playwright/` | Automate a real browser from the terminal via `playwright-cli` and the bundled wrapper: navigation, form filling, snapshots, UI-flow debugging |
| `parts/openai-playwright-interactive/` | Persistent browser and Electron interaction through `js_repl` for fast iterative UI debugging |

**Testing**

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `parts/playwright-pro/` | Production-grade Playwright testing toolkit: e2e suites, fixing flaky tests, test migration, CI/CD, reports, coverage |
| `parts/webapp-testing/` | Interact with and test local web applications: verify frontend behavior, debug UI, capture screenshots, read browser logs |

**Capture**

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `parts/full-page-screenshot/` | Full-page / long / complete-page captures via CDP: SPA scroll containers, lazy-loaded images, very tall pages, zero external dependencies |

**Device**

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `parts/android-adb-automation/` | Drive Android via USB: dump+parse UI hierarchy, tap/type/swipe, MIUI restrictions, read SMS from inbox, open incognito tabs |

## Choosing

- **Engine undecided** → `parts/browser-automation/` first; it routes to the rest.
- **Anti-detect / login flows with 2FA** → `parts/browsermcp-automation/`.
- **Test suite, CI, flaky tests** → `parts/playwright-pro/`;
  one-off checks of a local app → `parts/webapp-testing/`.
- **A tall-page screenshot** → `parts/full-page-screenshot/`. (The former
  OS-level screenshot skill was Codex-bound and is archived; on Windows use
  Win+Shift+S / the OS tool, and say so in the answer.)
- **Android phone/tablet** → `parts/android-adb-automation/`.

Reverse-engineering a browser *extension* stays in
`reverse-engineering/parts/browser-extension-reverse/`; researching the web
(camoufox-powered search with citations) stays in `web-research-camoufox`.
